title: Terms of Use
intro: These terms describe the informational purpose of the 2M Designers website. A signed quotation, statement of work or service agreement governs purchased work.

sections.title: Website information
sections.body: Descriptions explain the capabilities and services offered by 2M Designers. Compatibility, scope, delivery schedule, support windows and price are confirmed for each engagement. A website enquiry or demo request does not form a paid contract.

sections.title: Using the website
sections.body: Use the website lawfully. Do not interfere with its availability, submit spam, attempt unauthorised access or send information you are not entitled to share.

sections.title: Content and intellectual property
sections.body: 2M Designers branding and original website content belong to their respective owners. Stock photographs remain subject to their source licences. Source-code ownership and licensing for commissioned work are set out in the signed agreement.

sections.title: Examples and case studies
sections.body: Case studies describe a particular scope and implementation. Illustrative calculations show their assumptions. Neither is a promise of a particular saving, commercial outcome or search-engine position.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: Links to social platforms, WhatsApp and external references are provided for convenience. Their availability, terms and privacy practices are controlled by their operators.

sections.title: Corrections and availability
sections.body: Content may be revised as offerings change. If you identify an error, please contact us. Confirm requirements with the team before relying on website information for a purchase or operational decision.
